File upload succeeds (POST /api/uploads/media-temp -> 200), form Modal reopens with all state intact (tooth 26 preserved) and IOPA button turns green 'IOPA uploaded'. critical_code_review_comments: AddImplantSection.handleIopa relies on a fixed 250ms setTimeout to allow the RN Modal to unmount before the picker overlay renders. This works but is timing-fragile; a more robust approach is to use requestAnimationFrame + onDismiss/onShow callbacks of the Modal, or to convert the Add-Implant form to a plain View overlay so it stacks the same way as the picker (like survival-review).

Same underlying platform quirk (RN Modal above plain View overlay) could bite any other form Modal that later tries to use showUploadPicker — consider hoisting the hide/reopen dance into showUploadPicker itself (accept an optional hostModalSetter) or expose a shared usePickerWithinModal() hook so future call sites don't have to remember this workaround.
